announcements.title: Welcome to the BCIHS Library Portal
announcements.preview: Discover your next read and manage your library requests in one place.
announcements.body:
Discover your next read and manage your library requests in one place.

Explore the book collection, search by title or author, and check which books are available. Sign in to request a book, follow its progress, and view your borrowing history.

The portal also brings library guides and announcements together so you can find useful information quickly. For questions about your account, a book, or a return, ask the library staff for assistance.

announcements.title: How to Borrow Books
announcements.preview: Find a book, submit a request, and wait for staff approval before pickup.
announcements.body:
Find a book, submit a request, and wait for staff approval before pickup.

Sign in to your approved account and open Book List. Choose an available title and submit a borrowing request. You can follow the request in your profile under Borrowing History.

When staff approve your request, it becomes ready for pickup. Approval reserves a copy; it does not start the loan. At the library, authorized staff verify your request, confirm the physical handover, and record checkout. Review the saved due date in your borrowing history and return the book to library staff when you are finished. If no copy is available, check whether a reservation is offered for the title.

announcements.title: QR Code Book Pickup Guide
announcements.preview: Show the pickup QR for your approved borrowing request to authorized library staff.
announcements.body:
Show the pickup QR for your approved borrowing request to authorized library staff.

Open your profile, select Borrowing History, and find an approved request awaiting pickup. Choose Show Pickup QR and present the code to library staff. If the request status has changed, refresh the page to load the current details.

The QR identifies your approved request, not a physical book. After scanning, staff sign in through the staff login, review the borrower and book details, and confirm checkout when the book is handed over. Scanning alone does not change borrowing or inventory records. A completed request cannot be checked out again using the same QR.

announcements.title: Library Reminders and Proper Book Care
announcements.preview: Keep books in good condition and stay informed about your borrowing records.
announcements.body:
Keep books in good condition and stay informed about your borrowing records.

Use a bookmark to keep your place and avoid folding pages or writing in library books. Keep books away from food, liquids, and damp surfaces, and carry them carefully.

Check your borrowing history for the due date recorded at checkout. Return books directly to library staff so the return can be recorded. If a book is damaged, missing, or difficult to return on time, speak with staff promptly. Ask the library for current opening hours and approved borrowing policies.
